metadata.name: HK Construction RA Master Database v1
metadata.risk_matrix: 5x5 Likelihood x Severity; Low 1-6, Medium 8-12, High 15-25
metadata.legal_note: Use legal reference tags only; exact clauses to be verified by Safety Officer.

hazard_library.trigger_keywords: 開工, briefing, MS, RA, toolbox
hazard_library.specific_hazard: 工人不了解施工方法、危害及 permit 條件
hazard_library.possible_consequence: 錯誤操作、受傷、事故擴大
hazard_library.mandatory_controls: 開工前講解 MS/RA/PTW；確認工人資格、PPE、工具、機械證書；分配 supervisor；現場工序與 RA 一致
hazard_library.emergency_response: 停工；重新 briefing；SO / supervisor 確認後復工
hazard_library.ppe_required: Helmet, safety shoes, gloves, task PPE
hazard_library.checker_rule: Missing briefing/FCS for high-risk work = REVISE

hazard_library.work_activity: 工作區圍封及 danger zone control
hazard_library.trigger_keywords: 圍封, danger zone, exclusion zone, access
hazard_library.specific_hazard: 非施工人員進入危險區
hazard_library.possible_consequence: 被車撞、被墮物擊中、跌入開口
hazard_library.mandatory_controls: 硬圍欄、warning signs、指定出入口、watchman / banksman；開工前清場；禁止交叉作業
hazard_library.emergency_response: 即時清場；加強圍封；如受傷按 emergency plan
hazard_library.checker_rule: If falling object/lifting but no exclusion zone = CRITICAL

hazard_library.trigger_keywords: housekeeping, 清理, 通道, 電線, 積水
hazard_library.specific_hazard: 通道阻塞、材料亂放、釘板、電線橫跨、積水
hazard_library.possible_consequence: 絆倒、滑倒、刺傷、逃生受阻
hazard_library.mandatory_controls: 每日清理；電線掛高；釘板反釘或移走；通道/消防設備前禁堆物；收工前清掃
hazard_library.emergency_response: 停用危險區；急救；清理後復工
hazard_library.checker_rule: Blocked access/egress = REVISE

hazard_library.trigger_keywords: 物料, storage, 堆放, stacking
hazard_library.specific_hazard: 堆疊過高、物料倒塌、超 loading、阻塞通道
hazard_library.possible_consequence: 壓傷、火警、通道阻塞、逃生受阻
hazard_library.mandatory_controls: 指定儲存區；限高；重物低放；成束綁好；易燃品分隔；標示 load limit；保持通道
hazard_library.emergency_response: 圍封倒塌區；移除不穩物料；火警按 fire emergency
hazard_library.inspection_records: Housekeeping inspection; load limit record if applicable
hazard_library.checker_rule: Storage on platform without load check = REVISE

hazard_library.trigger_keywords: night work, 夜間, 照明, low light
hazard_library.specific_hazard: 視線不足、誤入危險區、交通風險
hazard_library.mandatory_controls: 提供足夠照明；臨時照明防水；反光衣；行人/車輛路線分隔；照明線路保護
hazard_library.emergency_response: 停工改善照明；事故急救及封鎖
hazard_library.checker_rule: Poor visibility and lifting/plant work continues = CRITICAL

hazard_library.specific_hazard: 上下交叉、吊運與地面工人重疊、熱工近易燃物
hazard_library.possible_consequence: 墮物、火警、撞擊、多人受傷
hazard_library.mandatory_controls: daily coordination meeting；分區分時段；禁止上下同區作業；PTW coordination；現場 supervisor 協調
hazard_library.emergency_response: 停止其中一項高危工序；重新協調及更新 RA
hazard_library.checker_rule: Simultaneous up/down work = CRITICAL

hazard_library.work_activity: 一般 PPE 及 Y-type chin strap
hazard_library.trigger_keywords: PPE, 安全帽, Y帶, safety shoes
hazard_library.specific_hazard: PPE 不足或錯誤使用
hazard_library.possible_consequence: 頭部受傷、眼傷、手足受傷
hazard_library.mandatory_controls: 全地盤安全帽、Y-type chin strap、安全鞋、反光衣；按工序加眼罩、耳塞、安全帶、手套、RPE
hazard_library.emergency_response: 停工更換 PPE；受傷急救
hazard_library.checker_rule: PPE cannot be the only control for high-risk hazards

hazard_library.work_activity: 事故、near miss、不安全情況報告
hazard_library.specific_hazard: 未即時報告事故或危險情況
hazard_library.possible_consequence: 事故擴大、重複事故、延誤救援
hazard_library.mandatory_controls: 所有事故、near miss、不安全情況即時報告；保留現場；啟動調查
hazard_library.emergency_response: 急救、封鎖、通知管理層及相關機構
hazard_library.checker_rule: No emergency response = REVISE

hazard_library.specific_hazard: 吸煙引致火警或違反地盤政策
hazard_library.mandatory_controls: 全地盤禁煙；張貼 no smoking policy；分判監管；違規按 disciplinary system 處理
hazard_library.emergency_response: 發現吸煙即停工/處分；火警按 fire emergency
hazard_library.checker_rule: Smoking in fire-risk area = CRITICAL

hazard_library.specific_hazard: 未受訓或未授權操作機械/工具
hazard_library.mandatory_controls: 確認 Green Card、特定訓練、操作證；未授權不得操作 plant / tools；job specific training 及 test
hazard_library.emergency_response: 停工；重新安排合資格人員；補訓
hazard_library.checker_rule: Missing operator qualification = CRITICAL

hazard_library.work_activity: 樓邊、臨邊、外牆、高位作業
hazard_library.trigger_keywords: 高處, 臨邊, edge, facade, 外牆
hazard_library.specific_hazard: 人體從高處墮下
hazard_library.mandatory_controls: 優先 safe working platform；護欄、mid-rail、toe-board；安全帶扣合格 anchorage / independent lifeline；下方禁區；工具繩
hazard_library.emergency_response: 啟動 fall rescue；通知消防/救護/管理層；保留現場
hazard_library.inspection_records: Platform inspection, anchorage certificate if used
hazard_library.ppe_required: Full body harness, helmet Y-strap, safety shoes
hazard_library.checker_rule: No fall protection/rescue = CRITICAL

hazard_library.work_activity: 樓面開口、洞口、樓梯口、lift shaft opening
hazard_library.trigger_keywords: 開口, hole, opening, lift shaft
hazard_library.specific_hazard: 跌入開口、cover 移位、未標示
hazard_library.mandatory_controls: 堅固 cover；清楚標示；護欄；不得擅自移走；定期檢查；lift shaft 加鎖及 warning
hazard_library.emergency_response: 封鎖開口；重新封蓋及檢查；傷者急救
hazard_library.checker_rule: Opening without guardrail/cover = CRITICAL

hazard_library.trigger_keywords: 梯, ladder, A ladder, step ladder
hazard_library.specific_hazard: 梯腳滑移、過度伸展、梯具損壞、站最高級
hazard_library.mandatory_controls: 梯具只作短時間輕工序；pre-use check；正確角度；固定梯頂或有人扶梯；三點接觸；不得長時間作主要工作台
hazard_library.emergency_response: 停用不合格梯；急救；改用平台
hazard_library.checker_rule: Long duration/forceful work on ladder = REVISE

hazard_library.specific_hazard: 吊船傾側、鋼纜失效、超載、強風
hazard_library.possible_consequence: 高處墮下、吊船失穩、死亡
hazard_library.mandatory_controls: 有效檢驗；合資格 operator；SWL；independent lifeline；full body harness；惡劣天氣停工；rescue plan
hazard_library.emergency_response: 吊船故障停用；啟動救援；禁止自行爬出
hazard_library.checker_rule: SWP without independent lifeline = CRITICAL

hazard_library.trigger_keywords: MEWP, scissor lift, boom lift, 升降台
hazard_library.specific_hazard: 翻側、夾傷、撞擊、觸及架空電纜、超載
hazard_library.mandatory_controls: 合資格 operator；地面承載確認；outrigger / wheel lock；不得超載；與電纜保持距離；emergency lowering plan
hazard_library.emergency_response: 困人即啟動 rescue；觸電先切電
hazard_library.ppe_required: Harness if required, helmet, safety shoes
hazard_library.checker_rule: No emergency lowering plan = REVISE

hazard_library.work_activity: 天台、脆弱屋面、天窗附近工作
hazard_library.specific_hazard: 踩穿脆弱屋面、臨邊墮下、天窗墮下
hazard_library.mandatory_controls: 確認 roof structure；crawl board；lifeline；edge protection；fragile roof warning；控制物料墮下
hazard_library.emergency_response: 封鎖脆弱區；fall rescue
hazard_library.checker_rule: Fragile roof without protection = CRITICAL

hazard_library.work_activity: 高處使用手工具、小配件
hazard_library.trigger_keywords: tool lanyard, 手工具, 高處
hazard_library.specific_hazard: 工具或小物件墮下
hazard_library.possible_consequence: 下方人員頭部受傷、財物損壞
hazard_library.mandatory_controls: tool lanyard；tool bag；toe-board；mesh / net；下方禁區；小配件容器存放
hazard_library.emergency_response: 墮物即停工；檢查所有高處物料
hazard_library.checker_rule: High work without falling object control = CRITICAL

hazard_library.trigger_keywords: lift shaft, 井道, 電梯井
hazard_library.specific_hazard: 墮入井道、臨時平台失效、墮物
hazard_library.possible_consequence: 死亡、嚴重受傷、物件墮下
hazard_library.mandatory_controls: 平台需設計/批准；井口圍封；lifeline / fall arrest；禁止拋物；CP 監督拆除平台；清理積物
hazard_library.emergency_response: 封鎖井道；fall rescue；通知消防/救護
hazard_library.checker_rule: Lift shaft work without permit/edge protection = CRITICAL

hazard_library.specific_hazard: 高處墮下、物料墮下、棚架失穩、鋸傷
hazard_library.mandatory_controls: 合資格棚工；CP 直接監督；安全帶及 lifeline；分段搭建；下方禁區；不良天氣停工
hazard_library.emergency_response: 棚架異常即撤離；CP 檢查後復工
hazard_library.checker_rule: Scaffold work without CP/Form 5 = CRITICAL

hazard_library.specific_hazard: 組件失穩、平台不完整、護欄缺失、超載
hazard_library.mandatory_controls: 按設計搭建；完整 platform/guardrail/toe-board；tag system；不可擅改；標示 safe loading
hazard_library.emergency_response: 停用 defective scaffold；修復後復檢
hazard_library.checker_rule: Incomplete platform/guardrail = CRITICAL

hazard_library.specific_hazard: 板隙、護欄不足、擅自改棚、超載
hazard_library.mandatory_controls: 不可擅改棚架；保持通道；不得堆放超載物料；定期 Form 5；發現缺陷掛停用牌
hazard_library.emergency_response: 停用並通知 scaffold contractor 修復
hazard_library.inspection_records: Form 5 within 14 days and after alteration/weather
hazard_library.checker_rule: Use of uninspected/altered scaffold = CRITICAL

hazard_library.specific_hazard: 拆卸次序錯誤、飛竹、墮物、失足、棚架失穩
hazard_library.possible_consequence: 死亡、多人受傷、棚架倒塌
hazard_library.mandatory_controls: top-down sequence；一人一 lifeline；CP briefing；Form 5 before dismantling；禁止飛竹；下方硬圍封；工具繩；清理棚上雜物
hazard_library.emergency_response: 異常移動即停工撤離；墮物傷人即急救及封鎖
hazard_library.permit_required: Scaffold dismantling permit / 4S PTW if applicable
hazard_library.checker_rule: No lifeline/exclusion zone for dismantling = CRITICAL

hazard_library.trigger_keywords: 拉抆, wall tie, tie relocation
hazard_library.specific_hazard: 提早拆 tie、臨時 tie 不足、固定承載不足
hazard_library.mandatory_controls: tie relocation drawing；先裝新 tie 後拆舊 tie；不得一次過拆太多；fixing/torque check；CP 全程監督
hazard_library.emergency_response: 發現 movement 即停工；工程師/CP 檢查
hazard_library.checker_rule: Tie removal without sequence/drawing = CRITICAL

hazard_library.work_activity: 惡劣天氣後棚架使用/拆棚
hazard_library.specific_hazard: 強風後鬆脫、平台濕滑、雜物飛墮
hazard_library.mandatory_controls: 惡劣天氣後 CP inspection；確認穩定、wall tie、安全網/catch fan；未檢查不得使用；濕滑控制
hazard_library.emergency_response: 封鎖棚架；完成檢查才復工
hazard_library.permit_required: No/permit for restart if site requires
hazard_library.ppe_required: Helmet, safety shoes, harness if at height
hazard_library.checker_rule: Resume after weather without CP inspection = CRITICAL

hazard_library.work_activity: 地盤邊界/行人路旁拆棚
hazard_library.trigger_keywords: public, hoarding, catch fan, 行人
hazard_library.specific_hazard: 墮物跌出地盤、公眾受傷、小碎料飛散
hazard_library.possible_consequence: 公眾死亡/受傷、投訴、停工
hazard_library.mandatory_controls: full height safety net；catch fan above hoarding；硬圍封；banksman 控制行人/交通；小碎料用袋；禁止拋擲
hazard_library.emergency_response: 墮物出界即停工、清理、封鎖及報告
hazard_library.checker_rule: Public interface missing catch fan/net = CRITICAL

hazard_library.work_activity: 拆落棚料臨時存放及搬運路線
hazard_library.specific_hazard: 堆疊過高、阻塞通道、棚料倒塌、公眾界面失控
hazard_library.possible_consequence: 壓傷、絆倒、逃生受阻、擊中公眾
hazard_library.mandatory_controls: 物流計劃；指定存放區；限高；成束綁好；內部及出車路線；有需要設 banksman；即時清理路面
hazard_library.emergency_response: 圍封倒塌/阻塞區；清理後復工
hazard_library.checker_rule: Dismantled materials blocking access = REVISE

hazard_library.trigger_keywords: mobile crane, 流動吊機, 吊運
hazard_library.specific_hazard: 吊機翻側、吊物墮下、吊索斷裂、吊物擺動
hazard_library.mandatory_controls: lifting plan；有效證書；SWL/load chart；operator/signaller/rigger；outrigger 完全伸展及 mat；exclusion zone；tag line
hazard_library.emergency_response: 吊物不穩即停止；降回安全位置；重新檢查吊具
hazard_library.checker_rule: Lifting without certificate/signaller/exclusion zone = CRITICAL

hazard_library.trigger_keywords: tower crane, 天秤, 吊運
hazard_library.specific_hazard: 超載、訊號錯誤、盲吊、吊物撞擊
hazard_library.mandatory_controls: 塔吊 CoP；load chart；clear communication；anti-collision where needed；禁止吊物越過人群；吊運路線清場
hazard_library.emergency_response: 停吊；通知 lifting supervisor；檢查吊運路線
hazard_library.checker_rule: Blind lift without communication = CRITICAL

hazard_library.work_activity: 吊運長料、喉管、鋼筋、竹枝
hazard_library.specific_hazard: 失衡、旋轉、撞擊、夾手
hazard_library.mandatory_controls: 正確吊點；雙索/spreader beam；tag line；手離夾點；下方禁區；風大停吊
hazard_library.emergency_response: 失控即撤離吊運半徑；重新 rigging
hazard_library.checker_rule: Long load without tag line = REVISE

hazard_library.work_activity: chain block / 吊鏈 / tirfor 使用
hazard_library.specific_hazard: 吊點不足、超載、機件失效、斜吊、手夾
hazard_library.mandatory_controls: 確認吊點承載；SWL；設備檢查；不得斜吊；不得站於吊物下；必要時測試 anchorage
hazard_library.emergency_response: 卸載；停用設備；CP/Engineer 檢查
hazard_library.inspection_records: Lifting gear certificate, anchorage test if required
hazard_library.checker_rule: Hoisting point not verified = CRITICAL

hazard_library.work_activity: 人手協助吊運 / 拉尾繩
hazard_library.trigger_keywords: tag line, 尾繩, guiding load
hazard_library.specific_hazard: 夾手、被吊物撞擊、走入吊物下方
hazard_library.mandatory_controls: 使用 tag line；保持安全距離；禁止扶吊點；banksman 指揮；設落位等待區
hazard_library.emergency_response: 吊物失控即撤離；停止吊運
hazard_library.checker_rule: Worker under suspended load = CRITICAL

hazard_library.work_activity: 吊機 setup / outrigger / 近坑邊架車
hazard_library.trigger_keywords: outrigger, mat, ground bearing, 坑邊
hazard_library.specific_hazard: 地面承載不足、outrigger 未完全伸出、近坑邊
hazard_library.mandatory_controls: ground bearing check；outrigger mat/steel plate；遠離坑邊；level check；雨後重新檢查
hazard_library.emergency_response: 立即停機；撤離半徑；工程師檢查
hazard_library.inspection_records: Ground condition check, crane pre-use check
hazard_library.checker_rule: No ground/outrigger control for crane = CRITICAL

hazard_library.specific_hazard: 盲點撞人、翻側、碰撞結構、地下設施損壞
hazard_library.mandatory_controls: 合資格 operator；banksman；人車分隔；倒車警號/燈；utility drawing；daily plant check
hazard_library.emergency_response: 撞人/管線損壞即停工、疏散、通知相關部門
hazard_library.checker_rule: Plant-person segregation missing = CRITICAL

hazard_library.specific_hazard: 撞人、翻側、超載、貨物遮擋視線
hazard_library.mandatory_controls: trained operator；限速；seat belt；人車分隔；貨物固定；horn/beacon；斜路控制
hazard_library.emergency_response: 撞人即停車；急救；封鎖現場
hazard_library.checker_rule: Forklift route not segregated = REVISE

hazard_library.work_activity: 電動唧車 / electric pallet truck
hazard_library.trigger_keywords: pallet truck, 電唧車, electric pallet
hazard_library.specific_hazard: 撞人、夾腳、貨物倒塌、坡道失控
hazard_library.mandatory_controls: trained operator；限速；load stability；行人分隔；坡道控制；轉角鳴號
hazard_library.emergency_response: 停機；急救；檢討路線
hazard_library.checker_rule: Material transport ignoring pallet truck risk = REVISE

hazard_library.specific_hazard: 倒車撞人、人車混雜、視線不足
hazard_library.mandatory_controls: banksman；reversing alarm；designated unloading zone；hi-vis vest；wheel chock；driver stop if loses sight of banksman
hazard_library.emergency_response: 停止車輛活動；急救及報告
hazard_library.checker_rule: Reversing without banksman = CRITICAL

hazard_library.specific_hazard: outrigger 失穩、吊物墮下、車輛移動
hazard_library.mandatory_controls: valid certificate；outrigger mat；operator competence；exclusion zone；load chart；wheel chock
hazard_library.emergency_response: 停吊；撤離半徑；檢查 equipment
hazard_library.checker_rule: No outrigger mat/load chart = CRITICAL

hazard_library.work_activity: 近行車路施工 plant movement
hazard_library.specific_hazard: 來車撞入、plant 撞 public、交通路線不清
hazard_library.possible_consequence: 工人/公眾受傷、交通意外
hazard_library.mandatory_controls: TTA；barrier；traffic marshal；lighting；signage；separate plant route；反光衣
hazard_library.emergency_response: 交通事故程序；通知警方/client；急救
hazard_library.checker_rule: Work near live traffic without TTA/segregation = CRITICAL

hazard_library.trigger_keywords: trench, excavation, 開挖, 坑槽
hazard_library.specific_hazard: 坑壁倒塌、墮入坑洞、缺氧、水浸
hazard_library.mandatory_controls: shoring / battering；edge protection；safe access；no spoil near edge；daily and after rain inspection；dewatering
hazard_library.emergency_response: 不可貿然入坑救人；召喚救援；防二次坍塌
hazard_library.inspection_records: Form 4 if applicable, daily excavation check
hazard_library.checker_rule: Excavation without collapse prevention/edge protection = CRITICAL

hazard_library.work_activity: 近地下電纜 / gas pipe / water pipe
hazard_library.specific_hazard: 損壞公用設施、觸電、煤氣洩漏、爆喉
hazard_library.possible_consequence: 爆炸、火警、觸電、停電、水浸
hazard_library.mandatory_controls: 查圖；CAT scan；手掘 trial pit；permit to dig；標示管線；近管線禁止機械直接挖掘
hazard_library.emergency_response: 停工、疏散、禁明火；通知 utility company / emergency services
hazard_library.inspection_records: Utility drawing, permit, trial pit record
hazard_library.legal_ref_tags: Electricity Supply Lines Protection; Gas-Safety; Excavation-Safety

inhouse_rules.rule_detail: 安全優先於生產；project management 發現 unsafe works / acts / conditions 必須暫停，直至已整改或隔離才可復工。
inhouse_rules.checker_use: If high-risk unsafe condition but no stop-work rule = REVISE

inhouse_rules.rule_detail: 未經授權人士不得進入地盤或受控房間/危險區；訪客及分判須按 site procedure 登記及接受指示。
inhouse_rules.checker_use: Unauthorised access into danger zone = CRITICAL

inhouse_rules.rule_detail: 從事建築工程人員須持有效 Green Card；特定工種須有對應資格/訓練。
全地盤禁煙，包括 direct staff、分判及訪客；違規須按紀律制度處理。
inhouse_rules.checker_use: Smoking in site or fire risk area = REVISE/CRITICAL

inhouse_rules.rule_detail: 全地盤最少佩戴安全帽 Y-type chin strap、安全鞋、反光衣；按工序加眼罩、耳塞、手套、安全帶、RPE。
inhouse_rules.checker_use: PPE alone cannot close HR risk

inhouse_rules.rule_detail: 工作地點、通道、樓梯、消防設備前保持暢通；每日收工前清掃，工具及設備放回指定位置。
所有人必須遵守安全標誌及指示，不得移走或干擾安全裝置。
事故、near miss、不安全情況須即時向 project management / SO 報告。
inhouse_rules.checker_use: No reporting route in RA emergency = REVISE

inhouse_rules.rule_detail: 工作時不得飲酒或受藥物影響；懷疑不適合工作應停止其工作並報告。
工地內不得嬉戲、打鬧或作危及自己/他人的行為。
JHA 應涵蓋 housekeeping、防火、吊運、人力搬運、高處、棚架、梯、洞口、墮物、電力、焊接切割、石屎槍、手工具、危險物質、PPE、臨時工程、噪音、流動吊機、E&M。
inhouse_rules.checker_use: Use as master category coverage check

inhouse_rules.rule_detail: RA 必須將 anticipated activities 拆成 job/tasks 作 hazard identification and evaluation。
inhouse_rules.checker_use: If work step too generic = REVISE

inhouse_rules.rule_detail: Safe Work Procedures 應建基於 RA 控制措施，並向相關高危工序工人提供訓練。
inhouse_rules.checker_use: Control measures must map to SWP

inhouse_rules.rule_detail: RA 至少每 6 個月檢討；如工序改變、事故、收到停工/改善通知，須即時檢討更新。
特定 operation/job 前由 Engineer、Site Supervisor、Frontline Staff 準備 FCS；內容由 SWP、MS、RA、COP 抽取，並向工人/分判 brief。
施工期間持續進行 Dynamic RA，監察現場變化；如條件改變須停工及修訂控制。
控制後 residual risk 不應仍為極高/高；若仍高，必須重新檢討方法或加工程/行政控制。
inhouse_rules.checker_use: Residual HR by PPE only = REVISE

inhouse_rules.rule_detail: RA team 應包括地盤代表/工程師、總管、安全主任/助理、安全主任、分判代表或有經驗工人。
inhouse_rules.checker_use: Missing representative in formal RA = REVISE

inhouse_rules.rule_title: Permit to Work for high-risk activities
inhouse_rules.rule_detail: 高風險活動必須行 PTW，包括 Hot Work、Permit to Dig/Excavation、Confined Space、Lift-shaft、220V equipment、Underground Work、Ceiling Permit、Plant Permit、Ladder Permit。
inhouse_rules.checker_use: Missing permit for high-risk work = CRITICAL

inhouse_rules.rule_detail: Permit 由 Site Engineer / Foreman in-charge 發起，根據 RA/MS/work rules/safety advice 檢查安全措施後提交批核。
Permit 批核後須現場展示；permit 過期、工作條件改變或工序更改即須取消及重新申請。
電房/天花等 ESSW 管制位置，每間房/每位置獨立申請，不可一張 permit 覆蓋多房。

inhouse_rules.rule_title: No cross trade in ESSW rooms
inhouse_rules.rule_detail: 已通電房間或天花 permit 工作只可一間分判進行，不可交叉作業。
inhouse_rules.checker_use: Cross trade in energized room = CRITICAL

inhouse_rules.rule_title: Same day cancellation for ESSW permits
inhouse_rules.rule_detail: ESSW 進入工程許可證、16A、天花 permit 須當日完成撤離、檢查、註銷並交回安全部存檔。
通電前由電業承辦商檢查和測試，再由華營聯同覆查；確認門鎖、收口、無外露電線。
通電後須實行工作許可證制度、掛牌上鎖、RA 及相關安全措施。
inhouse_rules.checker_use: Work after energisation without PTW/LOTO = CRITICAL

inhouse_rules.rule_detail: 總電掣房、分層電掣房、水泵房/風櫃房等已接駁電源房間及天花工作均須 permit。
inhouse_rules.checker_use: Access energized rooms without permit = CRITICAL

inhouse_rules.rule_detail: 房間接駁電力後須關門上鎖；房間負責人持匙，華營保管備用匙；房間無人時須鎖門。
維修/檢查前由負責註冊電工關掣並掛牌上鎖；完成後由負責電工確認安全才解鎖復電。
地盤基本不准帶電工作；如必要，須特別會議確認必要性、RA/MS 審批、相關方批准及使用絕緣 PPE。
inhouse_rules.checker_use: Live work without approval = AUTO FAIL

inhouse_rules.rule_detail: 每日早操/安全早會：簡報特別工程、危險區域、預防措施、PPE 檢查及安全規定。
由管工主持，識別危害、認識風險、制定預防措施，確保工人了解工序及安全要求。
inhouse_rules.checker_use: If RA lacks worker briefing = REVISE

inhouse_rules.rule_detail: 開工前由個人、plant operator、foreman、CP、engineer 等檢查 plant、tools、scaffold、materials；問題整改後才開工。
施工時由管工/工目監督是否符合安全指示及程序，並即時糾正不安全行為。
inhouse_rules.checker_use: No supervisor for high-risk task = REVISE

inhouse_rules.rule_detail: 每天在施工範圍最少巡查一次，由 PM/site agent 帶領並由 SO/supervisor/foreman 陪同。
收工後最後檢查，防火、水浸、失竊、棚架倒塌、擅闖等；工具設備放回正確位置。
inhouse_rules.checker_use: Add for works leaving temporary hazards

inhouse_rules.rule_detail: 每週聯合巡查高危地方及安全協調會，協調下週工序及責任。
每月 safety committee 檢討事故統計、安全巡查、訓練、推廣及下月安全措施。
每項 temporary works 必須有個別 Method Statement + RA；Temporary Works Coordinator/Site Responsible Person 協調及簽 check certificate。
inhouse_rules.checker_use: Temporary works without design/check certificate = CRITICAL

inhouse_rules.rule_title: Safe access and edge protection for falsework
inhouse_rules.rule_detail: 臨時工程搭設/檢查須提供 safe working platform、guardrails、toe-boards、access；無平台時才用 fall arrest 並訓練。
inhouse_rules.checker_use: Falsework work without platform/fall protection = CRITICAL

inhouse_rules.rule_detail: 工具、設備、零件及物料不得放近 falsework/高處邊緣，以防墮物。

permit_rules.trigger_condition: 開挖、探坑、地下管線附近施工
permit_rules.cancellation_rule: 工作完成/條件改變即取消

permit_rules.trigger_condition: 進入沙井、渠管、水缸、密閉空間
permit_rules.cancellation_rule: 每日/每次 entry 按 permit 條件
permit_rules.auto_fail_condition: Confined space entry without gas test/standby

permit_rules.key_controls: 井口圍封、平台設計/檢查、fall protection、禁止拋物、rescue
permit_rules.cancellation_rule: 工作完成/平台變更/條件改變
permit_rules.auto_fail_condition: Lift shaft work without edge protection/permit

permit_rules.trigger_condition: 使用 220V equipment 或高風險臨時用電
permit_rules.key_controls: REW check、RCD/ELCB、防水插頭、電線保護、色標/工具檢查

permit_rules.trigger_condition: 地底、坑道、深坑、地下喉管
permit_rules.key_controls: 通風、照明、通訊、safe access/egress、rescue、health considerations

ai_checker_rules.critical_missing_items: CP assessment; confined space permit; approved worker; gas testing; ventilation; standby person; rescue equipment; no unprotected rescue rule
ai_checker_rules.comments: 任何一項缺失都不應 PASS

ai_checker_rules.critical_missing_items: safe working platform or edge protection; full body harness where required; independent lifeline/suitable anchorage; falling object control; rescue arrangement
valid certificate; SWL/load chart; competent operator; signaller/rigger; exclusion zone; lifting plan for non-routine lift; tag line where needed
ai_checker_rules.comments: 吊運必須有具體吊運控制

ai_checker_rules.critical_missing_items: CP/Form 5; sequence; one lifeline per scaffolder; exclusion zone; no throwing; falling object/public protection; weather stop/reinspection
ai_checker_rules.comments: 拆棚必須 hard-code scaffold rows

ai_checker_rules.critical_missing_items: permit; room owner/REW assessment; LOTO/isolation where required; no cross trade; key control; cancellation record
special meeting; necessity justification; RA/MS approval; live work permit; competent REW/REC/owner approval; insulated PPE
ai_checker_rules.comments: 地盤基本不准帶電工作

ai_checker_rules.critical_missing_items: RCD/ELCB; waterproof setup; water control; machine guarding; support of cut section; exclusion zone; service scan
hot work permit; remove/protect combustibles; fire extinguisher; fire watch; gas cylinder control where applicable; ventilation
ai_checker_rules.comments: 火警風險控制不可只寫 PPE

ai_checker_rules.critical_missing_items: collapse prevention; edge protection; safe access/egress; underground services check; water ingress control; Form 4 if applicable
plant-person segregation; trained operator; banksman where required; speed/reversing control; daily plant check
piling platform certificate/check; plant route; utility check; lifting plan for cages/casing; monitoring for adjacent structures; emergency route
ai_checker_rules.comments: 地基不可只用 excavation/lifting generic rows

ai_checker_rules.critical_missing_items: design/approved method; temporary works coordinator; check certificate; safe access; edge protection; inspection; no materials near edge
ai_checker_rules.comments: falsework / ELS / platforms 需 TW control

ai_checker_rules.critical_missing_items: SDS; ventilation; storage; incompatible materials; PPE; spill response; no ignition if flammable
ai_checker_rules.comments: 化學品不可只寫戴手套

ai_checker_rules.critical_missing_items: dust suppression/LEV/RPE; hearing protection/noise control; HAVS rotation/exposure control where relevant
hoarding/hard barrier; catch fan/covered walkway if falling object risk; banksman/TTA; signage; immediate clean-up; complaint/emergency response
ai_checker_rules.comments: 近公眾位置要獨立 row

ai_checker_rules.critical_missing_items: weather monitoring; stop-work criteria; secure loose materials; CP reinspection after weather; heat stress controls
mechanical aid; team lifting; route clear; weight/size assessment; job rotation; MHO training; avoid repetitive strain
Consistent Chinese or bilingual paired format
ai_checker_rules.comments: 避免中英亂插影響可讀性

ai_checker_rules.critical_missing_items: Use reference tag + To be verified by SO unless verified by source
Controls must be actionable/verifiable, not only 'be careful', 'provide training', 'follow MS'
Add elimination/substitution/engineering/admin controls before PPE
Recalculate LxS and check Low 1-6, Medium 8-12, High 15-25
Remove duplicate generic rows; use source_step_id + hazard_id
Separate cause, hazard, consequence columns
Revise method/control until residual risk is acceptable; do not approve if still high
